reason: The frozen runner rejected the first HTTP 200 C1 response because each claim object echoed its input text as an extra field. The registered success gate requires the required claim/status/citation fields and valid JSON, but did not prohibit additional properties. The echo exactly matched the claim text in the frozen request. This was a local validator false failure, not a provider or model-output failure.
compatibility_rule: Require claim_id, status, citations, and short_reason; allow only an optional text field when it exactly matches that claim's frozen input text; strip that echo only from the scoring projection; retain the original raw response unchanged.
interpretation: The parser change is applied uniformly to any arm and stage. It does not change claim scoring. Continue only the not-yet-sent frozen pilot rows; the already received C1 response is reclassified from the preserved raw body without a new API request. Held-out dispatch remains conditional on 12/12 technical completion and independent of pilot effect direction.
